action.act.alerts.enroll-local.title: Sign up for local emergency alerts
action.act.alerts.enroll-local.why: Your county or city alert system and the National Weather Service send official warnings. This is free.
action.act.assist.assign-helper.effect: In the replay, an adult in the household is assigned to help.
action.act.assist.assign-helper.title: Choose who helps {person}
action.act.assist.assign-helper.why: {person} needs help in an emergency and no helper is assigned.
action.act.backup.confirm-medical-backup: In the replay, {device} runs on a confirmed backup during the outage. How long it runs stays unknown unless documented.
Confirm a backup that works with {device}
This rehearsal cut power and {device} had no confirmed compatible backup. Check with the manufacturer or supplier which backup works and set it up.
action.act.comms.power-bank.effect: In the replay, two extra phone recharges are available.
action.act.comms.power-bank.title: Keep charged power banks for phones
action.act.comms.power-bank.why: A phone ran out of power in this rehearsal. Charged power banks keep the offline plan and alerts available.
action.act.comms.weather-radio.effect: In the replay, the household has a weather radio for alerts.
action.act.comms.weather-radio.title: Get a battery or hand-crank weather radio
action.act.comms.weather-radio.why: A radio receives warnings without power, Wi-Fi, or a charged phone.
action.act.fire.helper-reach-plan.title: Plan for {person} in case {helper} cannot reach them
action.act.fire.helper-reach-plan.why: In this rehearsal {helper} could not reach {person} without going through a blocked area. Plan a second way out of {person}'s room, consider a sleeping room closer to the helper or an exit, and make sure a smoke alarm can be heard there. Helpers never go back into a burning home.
action.act.fire.meeting-point.title: Pick an outside meeting point
action.act.fire.meeting-point.why: No outside meeting point is confirmed. Choose a fixed spot a safe distance from the home.
action.act.fire.practice-drill.title: Practice your escape plan twice a year
action.act.fire.practice-drill.why: USFA recommends practicing the home fire escape plan with everyone in the household.
action.act.fire.smoke-alarms.title: Review smoke alarm records
action.act.fire.smoke-alarms.why: Record smoke alarm presence and locations, review coverage, and record an actual functional check. A home marker alone does not establish these facts.
action.act.fire.verify-second-exit.title: Check that every room has a second way out
action.act.fire.verify-second-exit.why: In this rehearsal no separate second exit was available for at least one person. Check doors and windows in person and confirm which can really be used.
action.act.flood.higher-ground-plan.titl: Know your way to higher ground
action.act.flood.higher-ground-plan.why: Plan how to reach higher ground without crossing low-water crossings, including without a car.
action.act.generator.outdoor-placement.t: Choose a safe outdoor spot for {backup} before using it
action.act.generator.outdoor-placement.w: Generators must run outdoors, at least 20 feet from windows, doors, and vents (CDC). This spot is not confirmed.
action.act.heat.ask-blower.title: Find out if your furnace needs electricity
action.act.heat.ask-blower.why: Gas and propane furnaces often need power for controls or a blower. This is unknown for your home, so heating during an outage is uncertain.
action.act.medical.continuity-plan.title: Make an outage plan for {device} with your supplier or care team
action.act.medical.continuity-plan.why: {device} stopped in this rehearsal. Ask your supplier or care team what to do during an outage and where you could go for power.
action.act.medical.document-runtime.titl: Write down how long {device} runs on backup
action.act.medical.document-runtime.why: The runtime of {device} on backup is unknown. Use the manufacturer's or care plan's documented runtime; Dry Run will not guess it.
action.act.pets.carrier-plan.title: Plan how your pets leave with you
action.act.pets.carrier-plan.why: Your pets need a carrier or leash and a place that accepts them if you leave home.
action.act.refrigeration.cooler-plan.eff: In the replay, a cooler with ice packs partly covers cold storage. It is not a full substitute.
action.act.refrigeration.cooler-plan.why: Refrigeration stopped in this rehearsal. Ask a pharmacist how to store {device} during an outage, and keep a cooler and ice packs ready.
action.act.relocation.arrange.effect: In the replay, the household has an agreed destination and ride, and uses them at the first decision point to leave.
action.act.relocation.arrange.title: Arrange a place to go and a way to get there
action.act.relocation.arrange.why.coolin: This rehearsal removed your usual cooling, and there was no confirmed cooled destination and ride. Choose a destination and a person or service you can contact before a heat emergency.
action.act.relocation.arrange.why.displa: In this rehearsal the household could not stay home and had no confirmed place to go or ride. Choose a destination and a person or service you can contact in advance.
action.act.relocation.arrange.why.heat: This rehearsal left the household without heat at home, and there was no confirmed destination and ride. Choose a warm destination and a person or service you can contact before an emergency.
action.act.tornado.choose-shelter.effect: In the replay, the household goes straight to the chosen room. It is not an engineered safe room.
action.act.tornado.choose-shelter.title: Choose your tornado shelter room now
action.act.tornado.choose-shelter.why: No shelter location was chosen before the warning. Pick an interior room on the lowest floor, away from windows.
In the replay, the household has an agreed sturdy building and ride, and leaves during the watch, before a warning.
Arrange a sturdy building to go to during a tornado watch
A manufactured home does not protect against tornadoes. Arrange a sturdy place nearby and a ride, and go during the watch.
action.act.water.save-utility-contact.ti: Save your water utility's contact and advisory sign-up
action.act.water.save-utility-contact.wh: Advisories come from your utility. Save its contact so you can follow its exact instructions.
action.act.water.store-3day.effect: In the replay, stored water meets the 3-day storage target.
action.act.water.store-3day.title: Store {target} of water
action.act.water.store-3day.why: The CDC storage target for {people} people for 3 days is {target}. Your confirmed stored water: {stored}.
action.act.water.store-3day.why.unknown: The CDC storage target for {people} people for 3 days is {target}. How much water your household has stored is not confirmed.
action.act.water.well-test-after-flood.t: Plan to test your well after a flood
action.act.water.well-test-after-flood.w: Flood water can contaminate a private well. Contact your local health department about testing.
feasibility.ask-pharmacist: Ask a pharmacist how your medication should be stored.
feasibility.budget: Ask your supplier or local programs about lower-cost options.
feasibility.care-team: Your supplier or care team can advise; no diagnosis is needed.
feasibility.confirm-host: Confirm with the host ahead of time.
feasibility.generator-20ft: Outdoors only, at least 20 feet from windows, doors, and vents.
feasibility.landlord-for-repairs: Renters: ask the landlord about repairs to doors, windows, or alarms.
feasibility.landlord-or-technician: Renters can ask the landlord; owners can ask a heating technician.
feasibility.limited-storage: Limited space? Store what fits and fill clean containers before a forecast event.
feasibility.manufacturer-guidance: Follow the manufacturer's guidance for compatible backup power.
feasibility.not-safe-room: An interior room is not an engineered safe room.
feasibility.renter-permission: Renters may need the landlord's permission.
prep.shelterPlan.title: Review your tornado shelter plan
prep.shelterPlan.why: A suitable windowless shelter on the lowest appropriate floor has not been confirmed. Review floor grade, windows, access and household assistance. A marker alone does not certify a shelter.
prep.shelterPlan.manufactured.why: A manufactured or trailer home is not a tornado shelter. Arrange access and transport to an appropriate sturdy building in advance. Do not start driving to a generic distant shelter during a warning.
